question: Under identical four-player seeds, seats, opponents, personas, decks, board, Headlines, and Mandates, how much does changing only the focal institution alter win credit, Mandate, rank, and realized faction-ability value?

comparisons.question: Does Demis amplify Capability Rusher beyond the same seat played as Mark?
Is Demis's main effect still large without Capability Rusher?
Does the promoted Power Broker expose meaningful Coalition Lab value?
Does an infrastructure persona realize Vertical Empire's spatial and Build powers?

interpretation.authority: Diagnostic only. This report cannot promote a physical rule.
interpretation.pairedDelta: Positive left-minus-right win credit, Mandate, or rank advantage indicates the left focal faction outperformed the right focal faction under common random numbers.
interpretation.interaction: Compare demis_vs_mark_capability with demis_vs_mark_balanced to separate a broad Demis main effect from the Demis × Capability Rusher interaction.
interpretation.abilityRealization: Treat an ability with zero or near-zero realized value as a policy or implementation diagnosis before changing its physical text.
interpretation.nextGate: Any ability ablation or numeric candidate selected from this diagnostic must enter a separately preregistered one-lever unified audit on a second fresh seed bank.
